item.title: Lac bangles emerge as major attraction at Adibasi Mela 2026 in Bhubaneswar
item.description: The ongoing Adibasi Mela 2026 in Bhubaneswar is drawing large crowds, with the stall selling traditional lac bangles emerging as one of the biggest attractions of the tribal fair. The mela, which showcases the rich culture, art, and traditions of tribal communities, is witnessing a steady footfall, especially during the evening hours. Visitors, particularly young girls and women, are flocking to the lac bangle stall, where artisans are crafting bangles live using age-old traditional techniques.

item.title: 16-wheeler truck plunges off bridge in Sundargarh; 1 killed and driver critically injured
item.description: A truck labourer was killed, and the driver sustained critical injuries after a 16-wheeler truck plunged off a bridge in Odisha's Sundargarh district late on Sunday night. The accident occurred on the Jamunanaki bridge under the jurisdiction of Biramitrapur police station. According to preliminary reports, the truck lost control after hitting the divider on the bridge and fell into the Sankh River below. item.title: Gold, silver prices decline for fourth straight day, offering relief to buyers
item.description: Gold and silver prices continued to decline for the fourth consecutive day on Monday, bringing much-needed relief to consumers after a prolonged period of sharp price increases. The steady fall in precious metal rates over the past four days reflects shifting market conditions and increased profit booking by investors.
